name: implementer
description: An implementer subagent (Haiku, Sonnet or Opus, your choice) plus an /implementer:implement workflow that delegates an approved plan and then reviews the diff and runs the checks.

model.title: Implementer model
model.description: Model the implementer subagent runs on. haiku is fastest and cheapest; sonnet is stronger for multi-file or less mechanical plans; opus is strongest and most expensive.
